status: pre-registered before filing the requests (research account, not the grant)
why: The B-B grant went to lab-vernier, so the grant design (r0 3.0, T 2.0, one run) is not run. Its window was inside the contact regime (notebook design concern). Replaced by a long radial fall with the H20 geometry, which spans r 9 to about 2 and gives leverage on the shape of S(r).

requests.001: B-B radial fall, horizontal, A-style geometry: B at (0.5, 5.0) and (9.5, 5.0), at rest, T 12, dt 0.01, tracker.
requests.002: A-A control, identical geometry to 001 (A at both ends). Same-geometry comparison.
requests.003: B-B vertical replicate: B at (5.0, 0.5) and (5.0, 9.5), at rest, T 12, dt 0.01, tracker.
requests.004: A-B vertical replicate of H20 (2026-11-25/r3/lab-b/001): A at (5.0, 0.5), B at (5.0, 9.5), at rest, T 12, dt 0.01, tracker.

analysis.window: Tracker separation > 2.0 at every sample used (pre-contact). Samples with separation <= 2.0 are dropped before fitting.
analysis.model: Relative coordinate obeys r'' = -S(r)/r^2.5 with S piecewise constant in bands [8,9.5), [6,8), [4,6), [2,4). Power P fixed at 2.5 for the primary comparison. A free-P fit is secondary and not pre-registered.
analysis.ratio_check: Momentum conservation: slope of x_A on x_B within each band is -m_B/m_A. Errors-in-variables correction with sigma 0.05 on x_B.
analysis.H23_shared_law: Falsified if the band-wise ratio S_BB(r)/S_AA(r), comparing 001 with 002 on the same geometry, differs between any two bands (3 to 4 vs 8 to 9.5) by more than 3 combined standard errors. Not falsified if it is constant within errors. Power note: the ratio's error budget is set by the data, so a null result means consistent, not precise.
analysis.H20_orientation: Falsified if any band S_vertical(r) differs from S_horizontal(r) (H20 run 2026-11-25/r3/lab-b/001 vs 004) by more than 3 combined standard errors.
analysis.ratio_criterion: H20 unchanged: |K_B/K_A - 1.41| > 0.1 in any band falsifies the fixed-ratio claim. The K_A(9) criterion (11 to 13) is withdrawn: it was copied from the A-A table and does not apply to A-B.

budget: 4 requests, each cost 1 + 0.02 * 2 * 12 = 1.48 on account research. Total 5.92 of 40.
